data.modifications: None. The pinned source file is copied byte for byte, including unused brand metadata.

upstreamLicense.modifications: None. The complete upstream LICENSE is retained, including its notices for assets not copied here.

modifications: Statically import the local JSON instead of fetching the Claude Style host resource.
Accept provider, SDK model and a locale string defaulting to zh instead of a host context.
Return an empty string or the SDK description for absent or unusable model IDs.
Keep the original model-ID-first family order, then provider/model families, then model-ID-only tiers and locale fallback.

npm.comparison: Tarball SHA-512 and SHA-1 match npm metadata. Published JSON is deeply equal to the pinned source JSON; formatting differs. LICENSE and package.json are byte-identical to the pinned source.

releaseProvenance.evidence: Source commit read from the npm SLSA attestation payload; its signature was not independently verified.

scope: Only the model description JSON and lookup/localization logic are reused.
No fonts, logos, artwork or other upstream assets are copied.
The upstream THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md was reviewed and lists no attribution for the copied data or lookup/localization files.
The resolver returns display text only and performs no network requests, model calls, profile reads or writes.
